title: SM-16.13 - Can exceptions be granted for external users
intent: This article answers: SM-16.13 - Can exceptions be granted for external users
short_answer: No. External users cannot create new surveys themselves after 31 August 2026. Continued involvement in survey management must take place under EU institutional responsibility, with permissions granted by the institutional owner.
important_conditions: Users who believe their situation requires special consideration should contact the relevant EU institution managing their survey or project.
